select nextval('monitor_widget_config_item_id_seq')
insert into monitor_widget_config_item
id, widget_id, parse_rule_id, interface_id, protocol_config_id, item_code, item_name, is_selected,
values
#{id}, #{widgetId}, #{parseRuleId}, #{interfaceId}, #{protocolConfigId}, #{itemCode}, #{itemName}, #{isSelected},
mapper.update: update monitor_widget_config_item set is_selected = #{isSelected}, update_time = current_timestamp where id = #{id}
mapper.delete: delete from monitor_widget_config_item item where item.parse_rule_id is not null and exists ( select 1 from monitor_dashboard_widget widget where widget.id = item.widget_id and widget.task_id = #{taskId} and widget.widget_type in (1, 2) ) and not exists ( select 1 from telemetry_parse_rule_config rule_config where rule_config.task_id = #{taskId} and rule_config.is_deleted = 0 and rule_config.id = item.parse_rule_id )
mapper.update: update monitor_widget_config_item item set parse_rule_id = rule_config.id, item_code = rule_config.telemetry_code, item_name = rule_config.telemetry_name, update_time = current_timestamp from monitor_dashboard_widget widget, ( select current_rule.id, current_rule.telemetry_code, current_rule.telemetry_name from telemetry_parse_rule_config current_rule inner join ( select telemetry_code, max(id) as id from telemetry_parse_rule_config where task_id = #{taskId} and is_deleted = 0 group by telemetry_code ) latest_rule on latest_rule.id = current_rule.id ) rule_config where widget.id = item.widget_id and widget.task_id = #{taskId} and widget.widget_type in (1, 2) and (item.parse_rule_id = rule_config.id or item.item_code = rule_config.telemetry_code)
mapper.insert: insert into monitor_widget_config_item (id, widget_id, parse_rule_id, interface_id, protocol_config_id, item_code, item_name, is_selected) select nextval('monitor_widget_config_item_id_seq'), widget.id, rule_config.id, null, null, rule_config.telemetry_code, rule_config.telemetry_name, 0 from monitor_dashboard_widget widget cross join ( select current_rule.id, current_rule.telemetry_code, current_rule.telemetry_name from telemetry_parse_rule_config current_rule inner join ( select telemetry_code, max(id) as id from telemetry_parse_rule_config where task_id = #{taskId} and is_deleted = 0 group by telemetry_code ) latest_rule on latest_rule.id = current_rule.id ) rule_config where widget.task_id = #{taskId} and widget.widget_type in (1, 2) and not exists ( select 1 from monitor_widget_config_item existing_item where existing_item.widget_id = widget.id and (existing_item.parse_rule_id = rule_config.id or existing_item.item_code = rule_config.telemetry_code) )
